messages:
lee: heads-up — new hires hit a schema validation failure in samplekit --json-mode when a tool returned a top-level array.
tara: can you paste the tiny repro?
lee: tool emits:
```json
[{"k":"v"}]
```
our schema expects an object `{ k: string }`.
mike: parity bug: python helper used to silently unwrap single-element arrays for fncall/json mode; JS helper is strict and fails. also found a retry branch that does `return JSON.stringify(res)` on recovery, so the validator sometimes sees a string like `"[...]"`.
tara: ouch. options: (A) relax sample schema (temporary), (B) fix retry stringify, (C) add normalization in JS helper to parse strings and unwrap single-item arrays.
mike: prefer (B)+(C). i'll add a small util `normalizeFnOutput(raw, schema)` that: if typeof raw === 'string' -> try JSON.parse; if Array.isArray(v) && schema.type === 'object' && v.length === 1 -> v = v[0]; emit telemetry when coercion happens.
ci-bot: opened issue #3710: "devex: js sdk normalize fncall outputs + remove stringify-on-retry" (mike)
lee: i'll patch sampleapp locally to accept array until the helper lands and add unit tests for stringified-array + array cases.
tara: i'll add an e2e run with --json-mode to confirm parity with python sample.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for branch mike/fn-normalize -> build 9045 started
